name: wps-cloud-bridge
description: Preview package for the hosted ChatGPT connector to WPS cloud documents. Each ChatGPT user must authorize their own WPS account.

interface.longDescription: Find, read, create, and edit supported personal WPS cloud documents from a ChatGPT conversation. Each user connects their own WPS account; credentials are stored separately by ChatGPT user ID. This is a preview package, not a public Directory release.
defaultPrompt: Find my recent WPS cloud documents.
Create a Word document about tea tasting and return its WPS link.
